items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: if I was out playing that night, my sister would open the music store

ctx.x: Oh, I told you he went blind, and I used to have to lead him on the stage around. I'd lead him from instrument to instrument, and then he had a operation, and they put him on the table, and this operation, and they went down in there, and, of course, they didn't know much about eye operations those days, and they just cut out a piece of his eyeball--what do you call that?--and they cut it like it was a "V". It wasn't round. And he could see for...uh... and after that, he had to put his music up real close like…

in the morning or something while I sleep, and if I was out playing that night, my sister would open the music store, and that went on for three or four years, and he had his school, and he had a couple of girl bands and a men's band, and he taught 'em all and everything in his school and everything.
What was the name of his school?
